source: v96 opt-in post-receive capture remained false in all receiver trace frames because one_touch_finish_enabled excludes FINISHER from capture_context_agent_ids. Set teacher_profile=live_after_receive to disable that competing one-touch path; compare against existing v94 no-capture parent.
hypothesis: With the competing one-touch path disabled, measured-contact capture becomes active after actual finisher foot contact; it may preserve the ball for a later true foot shot.
paired_parent: v94 live teacher without capture on same consumed scenes
activation_gate: 3/3 actual receiver foot contacts and observed post_receive_capture_context active at least one frame after contact.
positive_sample_gate: Activation gate plus 3/3 six-G1 safe clean foot transfers, no early nonfoot ball contact, no robot collision, and at least 2/3 later receiver foot shots >=0.20 s after first touch with outgoing speed >=2.0 m/s. Otherwise reject. Even positive consumed-scene teacher data cannot be promoted.
interpretation: This is a causal activation check plus teacher reachability test; all scenes are consumed, no generalization claim or video permission.
